answer: Identity bonds decay like a lagoon draining away. Each agent posts a 60 POA bond shrinking 3 POA per epoch unless renewed by work; at zero the identity closes. Like ferrous metal in salt air, an untended bond rusts away: 1,000 fakes cost 3,000 POA per epoch, 60,000 locked up front. Each renewal sends a ripple through the public registry, exposing clusters renewing together. Honest agents pay once and renew from earnings.
